candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.note: Gilmore Lake is a high alpine lake in the Desolation Wilderness (El Dorado Co.), within the Lake Tahoe basin (Lake Tahoe Basin Management Unit) in the Glen Alpine Creek / Fallen Leaf Lake headwaters at the foot of Mount Tallac — but it is a standing lake sitting well upstream of the 'first lake' (Fallen Leaf Lake) on that Tahoe drainage, so the special Lake Tahoe tributary closure (§7.50(b)(152), which reaches only flowing tributaries upstream to the first lake, and the lake within 300 ft of their mouths) does not apply to the lake body itself. Gilmore Lake is not listed by name in §7.40(b) or §7.50(b), so it falls under the general statewide lake regulation §5.85(a)(1): open all year, 5/10.

candidates.summary: Open all year (general statewide lake regulation; not listed as a special-regulation water)

parameters.note: Anglers 16 years of age or older must have a valid California sport fishing license. Gilmore Lake is wholly within California (El Dorado Co.); no Nevada reciprocity applies.

candidates.citation: Eldorado National Forest — Desolation Day Use Permits & Parking

parameters.description: Gilmore Lake lies inside the Desolation Wilderness (Eldorado National Forest management), where a wilderness permit is required to visit. Day use: a free self-issued permit is required at trailheads during the summer quota season; day use is never subject to a fee or quota. In winter (roughly October–March) no day-use permit is required.

raw.permit: free self-issue at trailhead during summer

candidates.summary: Free Desolation Wilderness day-use permit required (self-issue at trailheads in summer); no day-use fee or quota

parameters.description: Overnight camping in the Desolation Wilderness requires a wilderness permit year-round; a per-day, per-zone quota is in effect from the Friday before Memorial Day through September 30, with 70% of the daily overnight quota reservable online at Recreation.gov (6 months to 1 day in advance) and the remainder available as walk-in.
